interpretation.headline: On surface 'offmcsa_bronze_high_confidence', fold-NN nearest-neighbour retrieval against the M-CSA train atlas recovers the true mechanism fingerprint for 132/156 scored positives (no abstention).
interpretation.note: Raising the fold gate trades recovered coverage for precision on the retained set; compare against the off-M-CSA abstention frontier when a non-M-CSA positive surface becomes available.
